jobs.description:
Want to gain practical management consulting experience while completing your degree? We’re looking for a junior consultant eager to help some of Europe’s most ambitious and critical organisations turn geopolitical instability, cyber threats, regulatory pressure, and fragile supply chains into a competitive advantage.

What you’ll do

As a Junior Consultant within Implement's growing Security & Resilience team, you'll join more than 25 consultants specialising in security transformation, OT & critical infrastructure, resilience, and AI security & governance. You'll help our clients enhance their resilience and security posture so they can thrive even in times of crisis.

Working alongside experienced consultants, you will:

• Research emerging threats, regulations and industry developments

• Analyse complex security and resilience challenges

• Support risk assessments, scenario analyses and maturity evaluations

• Help develop strategies, governance models and practical recommendations

• Prepare workshops, presentations and decision-making material for clients

• Contribute to proposals and the development of new approaches and services

You’ll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from the beginning. Your ideas and perspectives will matter, and you will receive the support and feedback you need to grow.

What you’ll bring

We're looking for people with curiosity, commitment, and a genuine willingness to learn. The role is designed for students, which means your studies come first and we will plan your workload accordingly.

We’re looking for someone who:

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education programme, typically at master’s level and is among the best in their class

• Studies engineering, computer science, business, political science, security studies, or a related field

• Has a strong interest in security, resilience, risk, cybersecurity, or critical infrastructure

• Demonstrates analytical and conceptual problem-solving skills

• Communicates complex ideas clearly, both verbally and in writing

• Works collaboratively and contributes positively to a team

• Is comfortable taking ownership, including when there is no ready-made solution

On top of that, it’s an advantage – but not a requirement – if you have one or more of the following:

• Familiarity with security, resilience, or risk management concepts and frameworks

• Awareness of frameworks such as ISO 27001, 42001, etc., or the NIST Cybersecurity Framework

• Awareness of EU regulation such as CER, NIS2, DORA, or the Cyber Resilience Act

• Strong quantitative skills relevant to risk scenarios and data-driven assessments

• Experience from case competitions, student consulting, or other extracurricular activities

• An interest in geopolitics, critical infrastructure, or organisational crisis response

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What matters most is your curiosity, learning mindset, and motivation to contribute.

You can expect to work approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility during exams and intensive study periods. On top of contributing to client engagements, you can expect to participate in our dedicated development programme for junior consultants.

What we offer

At Implement, you'll get meaningful client exposure from day one, working on real assignments involving complex, high-impact challenges. You'll receive close mentorship, frequent feedback, and paid, relevant training, as part of one of our four Security & Resilience communities, collaborating across specialisms.

The role is built around flexibility, so you can build genuine consulting experience without compromising your studies. And as befits an employee-owned consultancy, you'll be joining a strong company culture where we believe lasting change is created through people.

Make your next move matter.

About Implement Consulting Group

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consultancy with over 1,900 employees, making it one of the largest European consultancies. Headquartered in Copenhagen, the company has offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States. Implement supports organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. The company combines analytical rigour, functional expertise, and industry insight with a unique collaborative model and an ability to engage and mobilise client organisations.

Company Description

Are you the one who brings structure when things get complex, and who walks over to ask why something has stalled rather than waiting for an email? Then you might be the Student Assistant we are looking for!

At JYSK, our Operational Centre of Excellence helps teams across IT and the business units it supports work in more stable and measurable ways. We are looking for a Student Assistant for 15 hours a week to work with data and stakeholder coordination at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus.

You start as soon as we have found the right candidate. For the first six weeks you work about one day a week, then 15 hours a week over two days, with at least one of them at the office. We start with a three-month contract and hope you stay at least 12 months. We are flexible around exams and holidays.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You work directly with the Manager of IT Operational Excellence and get real responsibility from day one. Within your first three months, you will have delivered your first piece of reporting that the IT leadership team uses.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Insight into how IT operations and continuous improvement work in an international retailer with more than 3,700 stores in 49 countries, more than 35,000 colleagues and an IT organisation of more than 400 people

• Room to shape your own role - this is a new area we are designing, and what you lean into will help define it

• A dedicated mentor, regular sparring and a network across IT that few students get

• Hands-on experience with ITIL, Lean, structured change management and the agile framework SAFe, which is how our teams work

• The option to use real cases for projects or your thesis

• Flexible hours that fit your studies and exams

• Engaged colleagues, a lunch programme with healthy and varied meals, and Friday bars

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You help us turn improvements into results, and most of that happens in conversation with people. Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Data and insight: Collect and analyse data, build dashboards, and explain what the numbers show and how our initiatives are working.

• Following up on improvement actions: Keep track of our actions, check with the owners that they are delivered, and find out why when something stalls.

• Making larger initiatives easy to join: One example is our CMDB, a map of how applications and servers connect. You create templates, plan the steps with the teams and help remove what blocks them.

• Working with people: Talk to colleagues instead of hiding behind the screen. Join a stand-up, send a Slack message or walk over, and make it easy for people to help.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You do not need experience. We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Is curious about data and what it tells you, with Excel as a good starting point

• Enjoys bringing structure to messy tasks

• Likes talking to people and following up until things get done

• Is motivated to learn, not least how IT runs a large retail business

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education programme with at least 12 months of studies left

• Communicates fluently in English. Danish is a plus

• Can be at the office in Aarhus at least one day a week

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Manager of IT Operational Excellence, Jan B. Olsen at +45 2779 3597.

We interview on an ongoing basis and remove the ad once we have found the right candidate. You may be asked to work through a short case of about one hour.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click "I'm interested/Apply", you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values - Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit - express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.

Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Machine Learning Researcher at Alipes.

At Alipes, we have been the market leader in automating the financial markets since we started back in 2008, shaping a fully automatic natural language processing system for reading and interpreting financial news.

To accomplish our mission of being the best at what we do, we understand the importance of elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels. Your work will involve leading the efforts in creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to seamlessly turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the financial markets.

In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

• 
Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks

• 
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines

• 
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.

You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.

About the team

All of this will happen in an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done. We are a tight-knit modeling team with fourteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities – eleven PhD’s and three MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We are working alongside two other teams of software developers and traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. What makes this constellation work great is that all of the individual team members write code and understand that a seemingly trivial change can actually require a lot of work, and vice versa.

About you

• 
Fluency within mathematics and statistics.

• 
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.

• 
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.

• 
Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.

• 
A scientific and inquisitive mind.

Nice to have

• 
Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.

• 
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.

• 
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.

• 
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.

What we can offer you

• 
Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• 
A modern, harbour front office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• 
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• 
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• 
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• 
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and, in lieu of providing a cover letter, concisely answer the questions on the application. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

Should you have questions about the role that you would like clarified before applying, you're welcome to send an email to quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please note that applications should not be sent to the email address but rather via the job link.

Due to summer holidays, our response times may be a little longer than usual. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to reviewing your application.

Company Description

Are you motivated by shaping the future of JYSK through architectural direction rather than specific technologies? Can you inspire and coach teams to turn business ambitions into sustainable solutions? Do you thrive in the space between business and technology, translating strategic objectives into architectural guidance and helping others make sound decisions?

The technologies may change, but your passion for creating clear direction, strong collaboration, and sustainable architecture remains constant.

Are you experienced in within the domain of retail solutions and have a strong knowledge of what matters in software architecture within this domain?

Then you could be the one we are looking for!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

In JYSK your official title will be Release Train Architect and you will shape the architecture within our retail domain and influence the broader direction across JYSK—all in an informal and collaborative environment.

JYSK has strong ambitions in omnichannel commerce for creating even better customer experiences across all our channels. With over 3,500 stores and more than 100 new openings each year, retail is a core part of our IT landscape.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Sparring and feedback from skilled colleagues.

• A job where you get the opportunity to develop professionally and personally.

• A workplace in an exciting international company where results, expansion and development have a high priority.

• A relaxed and open minded atmosphere with rich opportunities to cooperate with colleagues at all levels of the organisation.

• Several social activities during the year, including Friday bars, DHL run, Christmas party etc.

• A healthy work-life balance as well as a strong company culture with a short distance from decision to action.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As part of the leadership team for our Retail Excellence ART consisting of 7 product teams, you will play a key role as the main architect in shaping the architecture that supports JYSK stores and the retail capabilities that enable thousands of colleagues to serve customers every day. You will help guide the evolution of our store systems landscape, ensuring that solutions are sustainable, scalable, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural principles.

In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, product teams, engineers, and fellow architects to provide architectural direction, facilitate decision-making, and create alignment across the organization. You are not expected to be the technical expert in every solution. Instead, you are a leader, coach, and trusted sparring partner who enables others to make sound architectural decisions and translate business ambitions into valuable outcomes.

Reporting to our Senior Enterprise Architect you will join a team of three Enterprise Architects and five Release Train Architects.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Ensuring technical governance and architectural roadmap within the ART.

• Collaboration and alignment with architects and solution specialists across the organisation.

• Writing solution designs within the domain of our retail and store operations.

• Guiding teams to the right solutions and being a visible sparring partner.

• Being a central sparring partner with external vendor on the POS system, being able to translate between tech and business.

You can read more about our department at https://job.jysk.dk/dk/head-office/it

The current tech stack includes Enactor point of sales system, custom development using the Java and React development stacks, SAP S/4Hana ERP backend. In recent years we have modernised our landscape shifting towards a more headless and event driven architecture.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

In your architect role you understand the importance of stability and performance in the daily work of a store employee. This will require you understand the importance of time to market in the business of retail. Furthermore, you can navigate and cater your dialogue to all levels in the organisation both in business and IT.

You are driven by the architecture discipline itself, understanding how principles, governance, collaboration, and long-term thinking create business value with a focus on translating this into actionable actions.

You enjoy challenging assumptions, facilitating discussions, and influencing decisions that shape the foundation of JYSK's future growth and transformation.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has experience from an architect position and possess good understanding of the architecture domains (business, data, application, technology).

• Are proactive, independent and naturally drives the architectural agenda.

• Takes initiative and achieves results which are aligned with the strategic prioritisation.

• Naturally creates results through others and are hands-on when needed.

• Has a curious and open mindset.

• Can translate business initiatives into architectural roadmap for ART.

• Demonstrates excellent communication skills at all levels.

• Preferrable have experience from retail.

• Naturally feels comfortable in a leadership role

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Senior Enterprise Architect, Michael Nyholm Telling at +45 4012 4218

Are you ready to develop your career in trading and gain insights into the energy markets? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you have impact from day one? At Alipes Capital, we offer the unique opportunity to work with highly skilled, innovative and fun colleagues while utilizing cutting edge technology.

We are seeking our next motivated Energy Analyst to join our growing energy trading desk.

About Alipes

We use machine learning technology for reading and interpreting fundamental and market data and execute our trading strategies based on this data. Since our inception in 2008, we have continuously grown and diversified into new business areas driven by our technology. Alipes aims to support liquid electricity markets and free flow of energy, which are crucial to facilitate the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources, thereby promoting a sustainable future.

We are centrally located in Nordhavn, Copenhagen, and have 80 bright and ambitious team members.

About the Job

You will be a part of a dynamic team whose primary responsibility is to develop new strategies and ensure that all algorithms and systems run smoothly on a daily basis. This means handling the full algorithm life-cycle from inception, through calibration, backtesting, live-implementation, validation and post-release monitoring and optimisation.

At Alipes, we offer a steep learning curve with responsibility and ownership from day one. You will have the responsibility for reviewing positions and overall exposure, as well as adjusting if applicable - this also includes shared on-call responsibility within the team for the occasional calls that come in outside of business hours. We take pride in maintaining a healthy risk reward trade-off by maximizing revenue under exposure and regulatory constraints. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our Tech and Quant teams.

About You

• 
You have a Masters in Economics, Finance, Mathematics or related field, or a Bachelors with some relevant professional experience.

• 
Experience working with Python. Experience with SQL is a plus.

• 
Experience with energy or trading in financial markets.

• 
Structured and enjoy analyzing large data sets.

• 
Conscientious with an eye for detail, even when tasks become routine or pressured.

• 
You take initiative and ownership in your work.

• 
Analytical and love working with numbers.

What We can Offer You

• 
Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• 
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• 
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• 
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• 
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• 
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Join Alipes

To apply, please send us your CV as well as a copy of your university transcripts/grades via the application link. You are welcome to contact us with questions at Energy_jobs@alipescapital.com.

Please do not send your application to the email address as our hiring team will not have visibility. We look forward to hearing from you!

Company Description

At Coach Solutions, we build software that helps the global shipping industry work smarter and make data-driven decisions — for both profit and sustainability. Backed by Kongsberg Maritime, we're entering a new phase: modernizing our architecture and scaling our impact.

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Developer to join our Platform & Development department. You'll take ownership of frontend development across our SaaS products, working closely with developers, QA, Product, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable software used by customers across the shipping industry.

Our stack centres on Next.js, React, Typescript and Vercel, backed by Azure and .NET Standard services, with Mapbox and tilesets powering our geospatial visualizations. We're an AI-fluent team — you'll be expected to use AI-assisted tools as part of how you work, not just be curious about them.

Qualifications

What you'll do

• Design, build, and maintain modern frontend applications with React and Next.js.

• Build interactive maps and geospatial visualizations using Mapbox and tilesets.

• Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs, including .NET Standard services — with room to grow into full-stack work overtime.

• Contribute to modernizing our existing architecture, with an eye on maintainability, scalability, and security.

• Own features end-to-end: from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and monitoring (via tools like Monitive).

• Use GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control, code review, and CI/CD.

• Use AI-assisted development tools day-to-day to improve code quality, testing, and delivery speed.

• Share knowledge, raise technical risks early, and help shape how the team works.

What you bring

Must have

• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend and production software used by real customers.

• Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript/JavaScript.

• Solid grasp of frontend architecture: component design, state management, responsive UIs.

• Experience integrating frontend apps with REST APIs and backend services.

• Comfortable with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Genuinely AI-fluent: you already use AI coding tools and understand their limits, not just open to trying them.

• Clear communicator — able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have (we'll teach the rest)

• Experience with Mapbox, tilesets, or geospatial data — no prior background required if you're keen to learn.

• Exposure to Vercel deployment workflows.

• Comfort working in Azure-based environments.

• .NET Standard experience, or interest in growing into full-stack work.

• Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools such as Monitive.

Additional Information

Practical details

• Location: Copenhagen, on-site with hybrid flexibility

• Team: Platform & Development department

Why Coach Solutions

• A purpose-driven workplace at the intersection of tech and sustainability.

• Real influence: if you see the problem, you own it — and if you make the best argument, you win, regardless of title.

• An informal, social culture — monthly Friday bars, team events, summer and winter parties, family events, and more.

• A skilled mentor and an experienced, engineering-minded team eager to help you succeed.

• Room to grow — new responsibilities and career paths as the company scales.

Don't check every box?

That's okay — we'd still love to hear from you. If you have strong frontend experience, a passion for building great software, and the motivation to learn and grow, reach out. Let's build something meaningful together.

Do you want to complete your MSc or PhD thesis in collaboration with a highly-skilled team that uses cutting edge techniques in Natural Language Processing and Algorithmic Trading? We are looking for talented students willing to tackle cool challenges in NLP, Algo Trading, Financial Time Series, Stock Market prediction and/or Portfolio Optimization.

In doing so, you would contribute to one of these project topics:

Infer sentiment from Earnings Conference Calls Redesign and introduce new text-processing techniques to extract additional and more accurate entities from the text-sources that underlie our trading algorithms

• 
- we are open in a friendly, skeptical way to fancy proposals - if you got ‘em, pitch

Nice to have

•

What we can offer you

• 
Exciting problems to solve

Collaborative team made up of kind and curious people

• 
Nice office in Nordhavn with a view to the waterfront

• 
Inclusion into our team-building exercises, including trips to Copenhagen’s coolest spots.

Practicalities

To apply, please send us

• 
Your CV

• 
Copies of your Transcripts

• 
A cover letter with either a proposal for a new project or a reference to one of our proposed topics above and how you are suitable for them

• 
At least one, ideally two letters of reference from a professor that knows you

Should your profile look like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

We also accept projects where two people work on it together.

November 15th for starting in January

As a Business Controller at Emmerys, you will take on significant responsibility from the start and play an important role in driving commercial and operational success. You will turn data into business decisions by delivering data-driven insights, conducting financial analyses, and working closely with management and the wider business. We are looking for an ambitious Business Controller who enjoys getting close to operations and is motivated by both taking ownership and continuously improving the way we work with data, performance, and decision-making.

Who are we?

Emmerys is a Danish organic bakery and café chain specializing in freshly baked bread, pastries, and high-quality coffee. Today, we operate 35 stores primarily located in and around Copenhagen as well as in Aarhus, supported by a nationwide team of around 600 employees.

Our headquarter is located in Valby with a combined HQ and production facility under the same roof. We are a dynamic organization where diverse professional backgrounds work closely together toward shared goals.

With strong growth ambitions and a continuous drive to refine and perfect our concept, we are committed to delivering excellent customer experience while evolving our business for the future.

Your Role and Impact

As a Business Controller at Emmerys, you will play a key role in supporting strategic decision-making and providing management with clear, data-driven insights that help drive our growth ambitions. You will be part of the finance team and report directly to the Finance Director, working closely with C-level stakeholders and contributing to the daily collaboration between finance and the operational teams across both our stores and production facility.

In this role, you will be involved in a wide range of tasks, and you will have the opportunity to influence how the position evolves and where you can create the most value for Emmerys.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Acting as a business partner to finance, commercial, and operational teams.

• 
Preparing analyses and reports based on internal data and external market developments.

• 
Managing larger cross-functional projects, for example within store profitability, performance reporting, pricing, digital initiatives and operational improvements.

• 
Evaluating previous investment projects and using insights to strengthen future investment decisions.

• 
Supporting budgeting processes and financial planning activities including capex material preparation

• 
Providing ad hoc analyses and decision support to the management team.

• 
Helping further shape this relatively new role and its areas of responsibility, with significant opportunity to influence where you can create the most value for Emmerys.

In your daily work, you will use Business Central, Power BI, and JetReports as your core tools, and you will gradually become a superuser in these systems as part of your role.

Your profile

We are looking for a professional and motivated candidate who brings a strong analytical mindset and a proactive approach to solving problems. You thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy working across functions, and are comfortable taking responsibility for your own areas of focus.

We expect that you:

• 
Hold a relevant academic degree in business, finance, or economics

(e.g., Cand.merc., HD(R), or equivalent).

• 
Have a few years of experience or is a recent graduate.

• 
Have strong analytical skills and solid experience with data processing and Excel.

• 
Work in a structured and detail-oriented manner, while keeping an overview of complex tasks.

• 
Are proactive, curious, and not afraid to challenge existing processes or suggest improvements.

• 
Are eager to learn, flexible in your approach, and possess the determination to see projects through from start to finish.

Emmerys as employer

At Emmerys, you will join a social and informal organization where collaboration and trust are central to how we work. We value a positive and inclusive working environment and enjoy coming together for two large annual company events, as well as smaller gatherings throughout the year.

Our headquarters in Valby are easily accessible by public transport, and when working on-site, you can enjoy our lunch arrangement and visit the in-house Emmerys store for fresh breakfast, coffee, pastries and much more.

If you have any questions or would like to hear more about the position, you are welcome to contact Finance Director Simon Funk on 25 14 08 09 or our current Business Controller, Oliver Søvsø, on 31 40 10 34. Oliver will be moving into a new role within Emmerys and can give you a first-hand perspective on the position and the team.

If this position sounds like the right fit for you, please submit your application together with your résumé and a short cover letter. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will get back to you as soon as possible. The position is available for immediate start.

Would you like to challenge your electrotechnical talents in global settings and to exchange ideas and knowledge with competent colleagues across the organization? At BEUMER Group, you will see the result of your work in the form of complex systems bringing together electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and software.

Take part in designing complex solutions

You will be joining our Airport Project Engineering or Logistic Systems Project Engineering team, who are developing and designing state-of-the-art systems for customers across the globe. You will participate in making the electrotechnical design, projecting and documentation and assist our electrical experts with sub-projects as well as day-to-day tasks. Your tasks will include:

• Participation in project meetings on the projects that you are assigned to – from design to commissioning

• Participation in design reviews with the team

• Electrical drawings in AutoCAD

• Various tasks in EPLAN

• Ad hoc tasks across the department

• Internal development projects like new safety functions, communication structure (like IO link), power supply solution etc.

Gain valuable experience in a specialist environment

You will be provided with a dedicated mentor, ensuring that you will have all the necessary tools and knowledge to get going, and who will be supporting you during the entire internship. jobs.occupation: Lead Consultant – Vulnerability Management; DK - Fredericia, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Can you translate complex technical security requirements into something the business understands and acts on - and challenge where necessary?

Energinet is seeking a highly skilled cyber security professional to join our Attack Surface Management team within the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the link between the department's technical specialists and the rest of Energinet and ensure that security requirements are both understood, prioritised and complied with.

You combine solid technical insight with clear communication and business understanding. You present innovative ideas with confidence, along with the presence and authority to guide decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the operation and continual improvement of enterprise vulnerability management capabilities across IT, cloud, and hybrid environments.

• Build, maintain, and optimize vulnerability scanning infrastructure, configurations, policies, and workflows.

• Develop scalable vulnerability assessment processes covering infrastructure, endpoints, servers, applications, cloud workloads, containers, and identities.

• Ensure accurate asset discovery, coverage validation, and vulnerability visibility across the enterprise.

• Manage lifecycle vulnerability processes from detection through validation, prioritization, remediation, and closure.

• Establish metrics and performance indicators to measure remediation effectiveness and risk reduction outcomes.

• Analyze attack paths, exposure chains, and security control weaknesses that could contribute to organizational risk.

• Develop risk-based methodologies for prioritizing exposures based on exploitability, business criticality, threat intelligence, and operational impact.

• Support continuous assessment of the organization's security posture through exposure analytics and attack surface monitoring.

• Serve as the technical owner and subject matter expert for vulnerability and exposure management platforms.

“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority.” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to

• Have a solid technical understanding in cyber and information security and can go in-depth with technical solutions.

• Have CISSP or an equivalent certification (e.g. CISM) - or are close to earning it.

• Is an effective communicator who can communicate complex requirements clearly to both technicians, project managers and management.

• Works in a structured way and projects professional authority.

• Have business understanding and the ability to question constructively and create progress.

• Be fluent in English at a high level in writing and speech. Danish proficiency is an advantage but not mandatory.

About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management - a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface.

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organizational processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors.

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk_.

• Collaborating with suppliers, colleagues and cross-functional teams across JYSK

We are looking for a new colleague who:

Help grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across Germany, Austria and Switzerland by building high-performing travel agency relationships and strategic partnerships that bring our holidays to even more guests.

Your mission

As our new Senior Partnership Account Manager, your mission is to grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across the DACH region through two interconnected areas: developing our travel agency channel and building strategic commercial partnerships.

As you’ll be working directly with travel agencies and partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you’ll need to be fluent in German, at native or near-native level, as well as confident communicating professionally in English.

You’ll own and grow relationships with travel agencies across the region, lead agencies through the transition from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, and identify new opportunities to expand our network. Alongside this, you’ll develop strategic partnerships from initial prospecting and negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

Working closely with Marketing, Product, Commercial and leadership teams, you’ll use market insight and performance data to strengthen partner engagement, extend Awaze’s reach and deliver measurable commercial impact.

What you'll be doing

• 
Own and develop relationships with travel agencies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with a particular focus on chains and networks.

• 
Lead the end-to-end transition of agencies from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, including change management, training and onboarding.

• 
Identify, develop and onboard new travel agency partners, maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective agencies.

• 
Proactively identify, pursue, negotiate and close new strategic commercial partnerships across the DACH region.

• 
Manage the full partnership lifecycle, from initial outreach and commercial negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

• 
Monitor agency and partnership performance, using data and commercial metrics to identify opportunities for increased adoption, engagement and growth.

• 
Collaborate with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to ensure partners are effectively supported and positioned for success.

• 
Identify co-marketing and co-branding opportunities that create mutual value and extend Awaze’s reach and brand presence.

• 
Act as a source of DACH market intelligence, sharing relevant trends, partner feedback and commercial insights with leadership and product teams.

• 
Travel regularly across the DACH region to build and strengthen relationships with agencies and strategic partners.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll thrive in this role if you’re a natural relationship builder who enjoys turning commercial opportunities into long-term, mutually valuable partnerships. You’re comfortable taking ownership of a varied portfolio, confident working independently and equally at home discussing performance data, negotiating a new partnership or helping an established agency embrace a new way of working.

Fluent German, at native or near-native level, is an essential requirement for this role. You’ll use German regularly to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with travel agencies and strategic partners across the DACH region.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

• 
Several years of experience in account management, partnerships or business development, ideally within travel, hospitality or a related sector.

• 
A demonstrable track record of growing accounts and closing partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

• 
Fluent German, at native or near-native level, alongside strong professional English, both written and spoken.

• 
Strong relationship-building, communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage agency owners, commercial partners and senior stakeholders.

• 
Strong analytical capabilities and confidence using performance data and commercial metrics to inform decisions and identify opportunities.

• 
An understanding of brand and marketing principles and the ability to represent Awaze consistently with external partners.

• 
A self-motivated and structured approach, with the ability to independently manage a large and varied account portfolio.

• 
Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, as well as other locations when required.

• 
Bonus points if you have experience within the DACH travel agency landscape, legacy travel booking systems or digital platform transitions, or have worked within or alongside a major European travel group.

• 
An established network across DACH travel agencies or hospitality chains, or experience with GDS tools and partnership management platforms, would also be an advantage.

How you'll make an impact

• 
Successfully transition and onboard travel agencies onto Awaze’s modern platform, driving strong adoption and engagement.

• 
Grow the number, quality and performance of active travel agency relationships across the DACH region.

• 
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective agencies and strategic partners, progressing opportunities through to successful commercial agreements.

• 
Strengthen retention, satisfaction and commercial performance across your agency and partnership portfolio.

• 
Turn performance data into clear insights and recommendations that help both our partners and internal teams make better commercial decisions.

• 
Work across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to unlock partner support, co-marketing opportunities and additional commercial value.

• 
Bring relevant DACH market trends, partner feedback and insights into Awaze to help inform product and business decisions.

• 
Champion Awaze’s brands and standards across every agency and partner interaction.

Why you’ll want to work at Awaze

We offer a versatile position in a strong professional and social environment - one you’ll have the opportunity to influence and help shape. You’ll be part of an international company that invests in the future, and join a dynamic, fast-paced department with skilled and committed colleagues who support each other.

We’re a people-first business - and we know that our success starts with our teams. Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll enjoy:

• 
Generous discounts on holidays across our brands

• 
Flexible hybrid working – with the autonomy to work how you work best

• 
Real opportunities to grow, learn and shape your role as well as careers progression vertically or horizontally, cross countries and responsibilities.

About Awaze

Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

Worth knowing

• 
This role can be based remotely in Germany or from our Virum office in Denmark.

• 
Regular travel across Germany, Austria and Switzerland will be an important part of the role, with travel to other locations when required.

What’s next?

If this sounds like the right next step for you, hit “Apply” and follow the instructions to submit your application. We tailor our recruitment process to each role to give both you and our hiring teams the best possible chance to assess whether this could be the start of a successful collaboration. You’ll hear from us shortly after we’ve reviewed your application.

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, and if you have any specific requirements or adjustments needed for the interview, just let us know when you accept your invitation - we’re happy to accommodate.

As a Purple Security Engineer, you will ensure operations can perform their security-related tasks based on guidelines you help define.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a Purple Security Engineer, you will be a part of Netcompany Operations and our dedicated Security team. Your work will involve defending critical infrastructure such as airports, large financial institutions, government systems, and other essential sectors. You will handle tasks ranging from identifying improvements and monitoring servers and applications to optimizing response strategies and advising colleagues.

You will be encouraged to solve technical problems creatively to find the best solutions. Open dialogue about different approaches to enhancing security is an important part of your work as a Purple Security Engineer.

You will be a trusted advisor for Netcompany’s delivery and project teams regarding how to solve security-related tasks. Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Engaging in proactive threat hunting to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.

• Developing and implementing response strategies to effectively handle security incidents.

• Responding to and following up on alerts generated by our SIEM and EDR solutions, including adjusting these to ensure precision.

About you

• You hold a degree or diploma in engineering, either bachelor's, master's, or have a similar qualification level in IT.

Would you like to take on a central advisory role where you help strengthen occupational health, support safe energy operations, and contribute to business continuity both onshore and offshore?

As Medical Officer, you will be a trusted point of contact for health and medical management across TotalEnergies EP Denmark, working closely with HR, HSSE, offshore teams, contractors, headquarters medical specialists, and external stakeholders.

If you are motivated by combining medical knowledge with stakeholder collaboration, proactive health management, and the opportunity to help protect and support our workforce, we encourage you to apply for this role.

Activities

Key responsibilities

As Medical Officer, you will be responsible for medical oversight and health management across TotalEnergies EP Denmark’s onshore and offshore activities. Your responsibilities will include:

• Medical governance and advisory support: Act as point of contact for the headquarters Medical Department, support TotalEnergies EP Denmark contract owners, advise on offshore medical service delivery, and provide medical oversight, expertise, and leadership across onshore and offshore medical provisions.

• Occupational health and absence management: Manage sickness absence, case reviews, return-to-work planning, workplace adaptations, and verification of offshore medical certificates for personnel travelling to worksites.

• Health risk, wellbeing, and business continuity: Monitor health concerns and pandemics, maintain site health risk assessments, promote healthy lifestyles, support wellbeing initiatives, and help minimize operational disruption.

• Compliance, standards, and health surveillance: Support health programs in line with country regulations, TotalEnergies standards, and relevant international standards, and conduct occupational health surveillance data analysis.

• Service and insurance oversight: Investigate medical service complaints or deviations, consult headquarters for medical expertise, and support HR on workforce medical insurance.

• Industrial hygiene and drug testing: Advise within industrial hygiene, support compliance, plan site audits, and manage the company’s Drug and Alcohol Policy and related testing.

• Stakeholder collaboration: Build strong relationships with HR, HSSE, offshore teams, contractors, medical service providers, government health authorities, and relevant Danish offshore committees.

Personal development opportunities

• Shape and develop a central medical advisory role with influence across onshore and offshore operations

• Develop your expertise within occupational health, offshore medical governance, sickness absence management, and business continuity planning

• Gain broad exposure to HR, HSSE, offshore medical services, and external health authority collaboration

• Contribute to health promotion, wellbeing initiatives, and continuous improvement of medical processes and procedures

• Play an important part in safeguarding workforce health, safety, welfare, and operational resilience

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total Rewards Package

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 753,000 – 1,004,000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance-based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

Candidate Profile

What we are looking for in a candidate

• Authorization to practice medicine in Denmark

• Experience as a medical doctor in emergency medicine, general medicine, an emergency department, or prehospital emergency medicine beyond student level

• Strong understanding of occupational health, medical governance, sickness absence management, and return-to-work processes

• Ability to advise on offshore medicals, fit-to-return medicals, workplace adaptations, and health risk assessments

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders

• Knowledge of the oil and gas industry is an advantage

• Offshore Energies UK (OEUK) registration as a doctor, or willingness to become certified

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement, as diverse experiences and perspectives strengthen our team

Additional background and experience

• Experience with occupational health surveillance, medical case reviews, and sickness absence case management

• Ability to work with offshore medical certificate standards such as Offshore Energies UK (OEUK) and the Danish Offshore Medical Certificate (DANOP) including fitness to work offshore

• Knowledge of industrial hygiene, health risk assessments, wellbeing programs, pandemic preparedness, food safety, mental health, and epidemic control is an advantage

• Experience from the oil and gas industry is a plus

TEST

Joining TotalEnergies means committing to the energy transition and helping provide energy that is more affordable, more available, and more sustainable for as many people as possible. You will grow within an international multi-energy company where every talent matters. You will contribute to ambitious projects and deliver concrete solutions to today's energy challenges.

Throughout your career, you will benefit from a wide variety of assignments and tailored learning opportunities. You will fully develop your potential in an environment that fosters innovation and excellence. Join committed and collaborative teams where success is built together.

We place respect and employee well-being at the heart of our performance. That is why TotalEnergies values diversity and promotes equal opportunities for all.

Join an international and multidisciplinary environment

In Aarhus, Denmark, you will be part of the Airport Electrical Project Engineering Team responsible for the electrical project engineering of highly automated baggage handling systems in some of the world's biggest airports. You thrive in a position where you can work independently overseeing several tasks and responsibilities across ongoing projects contributing with your knowledge, structure, and the ability to find solutions supporting improvements and best practice. Interested?

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship/scholarship, AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institut for byggeri og Bygni
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.

Qualifications and specific competences:
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:
• A MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related filed.
• A strong academic background and interest in HVAC systems in buildings, and fluid and thermal systems modelling.
• Proven experience in data analytics, machine learning, and optimisation.
• Ability to program using Python, R, MATLAB or similar platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and spoken English skills.It is considered an advantage if you have:
• Knowledge of animal heat stress and animal welfare.
• Knowledge of Large Language Model, stochastic modelling, system identification.
• Experience with CFD simulations.
Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering, Inge Lehmanns Gade 10, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Li Rong, e-mail: li.rong@cae.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Assistant Professor Tao Huang, e-mail: taoh@cae.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply:
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 30 November 2026 23:59 CET.
Preferred starting date is 1 February 2027.

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.
